title: Phase 7C.2 Normalized RAG Document Schema
description: Schema for the ingestion of OBSERVED investigative records into the future Phase 8 RAG database.

scenario_instance_id.description: The specific scenario instance directory (e.g., S11).

scenario_family.description: The topological family (e.g., S01). Derived during ingestion.

source_record_id.description: The raw ID extracted from the file (e.g., FIR-100/2026/NE).

timestamp.description: ISO-8601 timestamp extracted from the record. Null if genuinely absent.

raw_content.description: The untouched JSON object or parsed CSV dictionary of the original record.

normalized_text.description: Human/LLM-readable text representation of the raw record to be embedded.

entity_refs.description: Lexical extraction of raw surface entities (phones, names, accounts). NO GROUND TRUTH LABELS.
